artworks.title: Calothorax heliodori
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of hummingbirds interacting with a large flower. The artwork features a group of small, vibrantly colored hummingbirds with vivid green, red, and orange hues. They are hovering and perching around a large white flower with delicate petals and light orange stamens. The background consists of soft, pastel shades of blue and beige. The style is reminiscent of John Gould, known for detailed illustrations of birds. The composition conveys a sense of liveliness and highlights the beauty of the birds in their natural habitat.

artworks.title: Osculant Toucan (Ramphastos osculans)
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a toucan perched on a branch. The image shows a toucan with a large and curved black beak accentuated by a pale yellow marking near its base. The bird has glossy black plumage along its back and tail, and displays vibrant colors including a bright yellow throat and red markings underneath that transition seamlessly into its black body. Its claws are gripping tightly onto a textured branch, which is dotted with green leaves. The painting captures the bold features of the toucan against a soft, subtle background in the style often associated with John Gould.

artworks.title: Bird of Paradise (Paradisea apoda)
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green

artworks.title: White Headed Eagle (Haliaetus leucocephalus)
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two eagles perched on a rocky surface. The image shows a pair of eagles, one with a white head and another with a brown body and speckled plumage. One of the eagles is a bald eagle, recognizable by its white head and tail against its dark brown body, yellow beak, and intense expression. The second eagle is darker with distinctive brown feathers. They are positioned on a rocky landscape with green foliage and sparse grass. The painting is naturalistic, featuring detailed textures in the feathers and landscape. This is painted in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: The Crested Flycatcher (Muscicapa cristata)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: A bird with brown feathers and a yellow underbelly is perched on a green vine with clusters of small black berries and heart-shaped leaves. The color palette consists of earthy tones, including shades of green, brown, and a touch of yellow. The bird is situated in the center of the image, facing right, as it rests on a vine that runs diagonally across the frame. Surrounding the bird, the vine's leaves fan out, with one cluster of berries hanging near the bird's tail and another cluster above its back.

artworks.title: The Yellow Throated Creeper
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a branch with vibrant red seed pods and a green leaf. The artwork features a small bird with gray and yellow plumage sitting on a branch with clusters of red seed pods. The branch also includes a sprig with red flowers and a large, green, serrated leaf at the lower left. The composition is detailed and reminiscent of 18th-century natural history illustrations, similar to the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: The Spotted Ribbon Snake (Coluber nebulosus?)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a snake intertwined with various botanical elements. The composition features a long, slender snake weaving its way around and through a lush collection of green leaves and flora. The botanical elements include compound leaves, hanging seed pods, and flowers. On the lower right, there is a pink flower with a blue round fruit beneath it. The line work is precise and the coloring is subtle yet vivid, showcasing the natural details and textures of both the snake and plants with scientific accuracy. The detailed rendering suggests that this artwork serves as both an artistic piece and a scientific illustration.

artworks.title: The Coach-whip Snake (Coluber flagellum)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: A long, brown snake winds elegantly from the upper right to the lower left of the image. Below and partially entwined with the snake is a plant with green leaves, pink buds, and a singular orange-red flower with pointed petals. The color palette is composed of earthy tones, predominantly browns, greens, and muted pinks, set against a beige background.

artworks.title: The Hog-nose Snake (Boa contortrix)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a snake wrapped around the stem of a plant with blooming lilies. The snake has brown spots on a tan background, and the lilies have orange and yellow hues with speckled patterns. The flowers have curled back petals, and the plant's leaves are green. The snake winds through the upper part of the image, with lilies at the bottom left and bottom right. The color palette includes browns, greens, yellows, and oranges on a muted background.

artworks.title: The Glass Snake (Anguis ventralis)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: In this print, a long, slender, dark snake with white speckles and a bright yellow line running down its side is coiled in a loose S-shape over a pink flower with drooping petals and a brown conical center. The snake's head is on the right, past the flower, while its body extends to the left, its tail curving toward the bottom left corner. It has small brown eyes and an outstretched pink tongue. The pink flower stands lightly to the right of center, and it has a green stem and green leaves at its base. The background of the print is beige paper, and the snake seems to cast a shadow on the paper below it.

artworks.title: The Pole Cat (Viverra putorius)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows an animal with black fur and white stripes, along with a flowering plant. The animal has three white stripes on its back, resembling a skunk. It is depicted in profile, standing on the ground with a pointy snout, yellow eye, and thin legs with clawed paws. Below the animal is a plant with long green leaves and blue flowers. The drawing is detailed, showing the texture of the fur and the intricacy of the plant.

artworks.title: The Hawks-bill Turtle (Testudo caretta)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large brown turtle on the right side with a cluster of small, round blue-grey eggs nestled in a shallow depression on the left side. The color palette consists of earthy browns and greens, with highlights of beige and light blue. The turtle's head and left front flipper are slightly raised above the background, while the eggs are positioned to the left, surrounded by a darker brown area.

artworks.title: The Yellow Titmouse (Motacilla trochilus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a branch with leaves and berries. The painting depicts a small yellow bird settled among green leaves and clusters of dark purple berries. The composition is delicately arranged, with the bird positioned in the lower right section, nestled within the foliage. The leaves are elongated and prominently veined, adding a sense of texture and realism. The berries hang from slender stems that are a vivid red, which contrast with the deep purple of the berries and the green of the leaves. The background is a simple cream, serving to highlight the natural colors of the bird and plant.

artworks.title: The Blue Winged Shoveler (Anas clypeata foemina)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird. The bird is shown in profile, standing on a small patch of grass. Its plumage is predominantly brown with detailed feather textures. The wings have sections of blue and green. The bird has a broad beak with distinct patterning, vivid eyes, and pinkish-orange legs and webbed feet. The background is plain, emphasizing the bird. The drawing is detailed, possibly for scientific or illustrative purposes, reminiscent of historical ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: The Mangrove Snapper (Labrus griseus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a fish with spiny dorsal fins and a prominent tail fin. The fish is colored in shades of brown with a gradient that fades to lighter hues along its belly, complemented by darker detailing on its scales. Its eye is accentuated with a reddish-brown outline. The fish is positioned horizontally in the center of the image against a plain, light background.

artworks.title: The Porgy (Sparus chrysops)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image displays a fish with a dark brown back and a shaded, bluish-silver body. It has large yellow-ringed eyes, a prominent mouth, and a dorsal fin with sharp spines. The colors used are dark brown, bluish-silver, yellow, and hints of green. The fish is positioned horizontally with its head to the left, tail to the right, and lower fin downward near the center.

artworks.title: The Muray (Muraena helena)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a moray eel. The image shows a detailed and accurate representation of a moray eel, with its elongated, serpentine form curving across the canvas. The eel has dark skin with small, darker spots along its body. Its mouth is open, showing sharp teeth, and its eye is prominently depicted. The background is a plain, neutral tone.

artworks.title: The Black Muray (Muraenae helenae varietas)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large dark blue eel among tall, slender, branching coral structures. The eel is dark blue and black, while the coral is golden brown against a light background. The eel's head is on the left, with its body winding through the coral branches that rise vertically in the image.

artworks.title: The Cat Fish (Silurus catus)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: An illustration of a catfish is depicted with its elongated, rounded body and barbels extending from its face. The color palette consists of dark blues, grays, and hints of brown on the fins and barbels. The fish is positioned horizontally across the page, its head facing to the right and tail to the left, with its dorsal and ventral fins visible.

artworks.title: The Ribbon Snake (Coluber saurita)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a branch with green leaves and red and green berries, accompanied by a coiled snake at the bottom right. The color palette includes green, red, brown, and subtle yellow tones. The branch spreads out in all directions, with the snake positioned under the lower branches.

artworks.title: The Ribbon Snake (Coluber saurita)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large plant with clusters of green leaves and purple berries. A coiled brown snake with a striped pattern is located at the base of the plant. The colors in the image include shades of green for the leaves, rich purple for the berries, earthy brown for the snake, and a subtle beige background. Small pops of red can be seen from flowers among the leaves and berries. The snake is nestled in the lower right section of the image, while the plant extends upwards and slightly to the right and left, with the berries clustering towards the upper sections of the branches.

artworks.title: The Ribbon Snake (Coluber saurita)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image features a botanical illustration of a leafy plant with smooth, elongated leaves, clusters of small, round berries, and a coiled snake. The color palette consists of various shades of green for the leaves with hints of blue, while the berries are deep red and green. The snake has brown, olive, and yellow stripes. The plant's branches spread outward, some with clusters of berries at the tips. The snake is coiled at the base with its head slightly facing upwards.

artworks.title: The Barracuda (Esox barracuda)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two large fish side by side in a horizontal orientation. The upper fish is dark blue with lighter iridescent scales, while the lower fish is brown with a slightly golden tint. The background is a light beige color. Both fish are shown facing to the right, with sharp teeth visible and detailed fin patterns.

artworks.title: The Croker (Perca undulata)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two large fish. The top fish is brown with yellow eyes, while the lower fish is reddish with yellow eyes. The color palette includes brown, red, purple, green, and yellow. The top fish is positioned above the lower fish, both facing right. Both fish are detailed and set against a plain background.
